verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a programmatic SDK (TypeScript, Python, Go) for scripted browser automation. It can run against remote Browserbase cloud browsers or local/CDP-attached Chromium, and auto-caching turns agent workflows into deterministic scripts, all of which fit unattended runs. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a headless mode or CI pipeline usage, so this is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit headless launch configuration docs, CI integration guidance or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), independent corroboration of CI usage.
